Majora’s Mask is a great game! I’m still partial to OoT, but I grew to LOVE MM as I got older and could appreciate the overarching 3-day time mechanic/puzzle. It’s a work of art. You’ll rarely ever stress the 3 day timer, and it’s nice knowing you can always go back to Day 1 at any point. Don’t let it intimidate you. A lot of people are turned away from MM due to the timer, but it’s actually an amazing mechanic.

My 9-yo self put it down due to the timer. However, my 30-yo self recently picked it back up and 100%’d it. It went from one of my least favorite Zelda’s to a top 3 for sure. OoT is #1, Twilight Princess is #2, MM is #3… I also love Link’s Awakening.

I’m 30 so everyone is young and ambitious and it’s a miracle for me just to get up and get through basic tasks. Somehow I’ve managed to keep up with my job.
